messages:
Jordan P.: Heads-up — we need a concrete decision on the packaging matrix + upgrade orchestration for Private (VPC/on‑prem). Tradeoff: short customer downtime vs. simpler installer. Putting a proposed matrix below and asking for signoff.

Olivia M.: Posting the matrix please. we should call out IP/egress preservation constraints explicitly.

Jordan P.: TL;DR options: (A) Rolling operator-shim canary (minimal downtime, more infra work), (B) Offline package + operator migration (simpler but 30–60m downtime), (C) Dual-mode handshake (customer-managed NATs preserved, complex).

Samir K.: For customers with strict IP preservation, (C) seems required. but how often do we expect that? ~5–10 customers?

Nina (eng-ops): Confirmed: ~6 active customers asked for IP-preserve during last quarter. ops prefers (A) if we can automate rollback.

Kai L.: Implementation notes: (A) requires an operator sidecar that can own prefix swap and KV replay. We also need a canary scheduling API and a rollout window control in console.

Jordan P.: Proposed rollout checklist (initial canary):
- Define canary cohort (1 customer, test tenant)
- Operator-shim image + migration runbook
- Preflight: local e2e smoke + network validation
- Canary window: 2h monitoring + automated revert if token error rate > 2%
- If green, expand 25% -> 50% -> 100%

Olivia M.: Add SLAs: canary customers get opt-in credits and a dedicated contact. also add a prompt in onboarding for "require IP preservation?" flag so installer picks the right path. :white_check_mark:

Samir K.: Edge case: customer-managed NAT + overlapping CIDRs. Operator can't rebind IPs across NAT. we need an explicit fallback: keep relay path (relay-host) for those.

Jordan P.: Good call. Add to matrix: for overlapping CIDR -> fallback to relay mode (higher latency but no IP churn).

Nina (eng-ops): Monitoring hooks: need metrics emitted for migration phases: preflight_ok, migration_started, kv_replay_done, cutover_complete, cutover_failed. suggest a short schema to log in telemetry.

Kai L.: Example preflight check snippet:
```yaml
preflight_checks:
  - dns_resolves: true
  - egress_ports: 443, 80
  - nat_type: static|preserved
  - kv_replica_ok: true
```

Samir K.: Rollback plan idea: the operator should snapshot KV indices and feature flags, run a dry-replay, then either flip service endpoints or revert to prior pointers. This needs a signed rollback token to avoid partial flips.

Olivia M.: Product ask: define launch gates. my proposed gates: docs + runbooks complete, 3 internal canaries, 1 pilot customer, metrics and rollback automation validated.

Jordan P.: Agree. Also need packaging constraints: airgap support matrix (A/B/C) and minimal installer binary size targets.

Samir K.: For airgap: (B) offline package is the only realistic option. (A) depends on operator distribution channels — but we can deliver operator as tar.gz to customers with SHA256.

Nina (eng-ops): Action items:
- @Kai: prototype operator-shim and preflight schema (ETA end of sprint).
- @Samir: draft rollback token design + KV snapshotting doc (ETA 1 week).
- @Olivia: update onboarding flow and SLA language for opt-in canary customers (ETA next Tues).
- @Jordan: compile packaging matrix and update product PRD.

Kai L.: noted. will publish a PoC branch and ping this thread.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: canary-operator-poc -> staging at 2024-06-14T18:00Z :rocket:

Jordan P.: Quick question — what do folks think about making the default for new private installs be "safe-relay" and letting customers opt-in to IP-preserve? reduces risk.

Samir K.: +1. default safe-relay reduces blast radius. we should document latency implications clearly.

Olivia M.: +1 from PM. We'll propose opt-in in the console and a clear checklist for opt-in.

Nina (eng-ops): ops + support: +1, reduces unexpected field rollbacks.

Jordan P.: OK — decision: default safe-relay, support operator-shim canary for opt-in IP-preserve customers. Kickoff tasks above.

Olivia M.: I'll update the PRD and create a short customer-facing FAQ.

Samir K.: I'll start the rollback token PR and sketch the snapshot API.

Kai L.: PoC branch soon. ping me for infra quota if needed.

Jordan P.: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll mark this as the chosen path and ship the checklist to launch planning. :thumbsup:

Olivia M.: no objections from PM side.

Nina (eng-ops): no objections.

Samir K.: ack.
